summary: Murder conviction under IPC s.302 based on circumstantial evidence reversed; prosecution failed to establish conclusive chain of evidence; non-examination of investigating officer critical; ocular testimonies lacked corroboration, vague; undue reliance on hearsay statements; standard: reasonable doubt not met; High Court erred in affirming conviction on unproven facts; last-seen presumption insufficient without supporting evidence; benefit of doubt granted.
legal_provisions_cited: Sharad Birdhichand Sarda v. State of Mahrashtra (1984) 4 SCC 116
Shatrughna Baban Meshram v. State of Maharashtra (2021)
Pappu v. State of Uttar Pradesh (2022)
Hanumant Govind Nargundkar v. State of M.P. (1952)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction under s.302 and s.201 IPC set aside; accused acquitted; benefit of doubt granted; High Court judgment reversed.
